solve.work: Rectangle, square and rhombus are parallelograms (two pairs). Trapezoid has one pair; the last has none. Count 3.

questions.skill: Classify a triangle by its angles
questions.stem: Six triangles have these angles. A: $60^\circ$, $60^\circ$, $60^\circ$. B: $50^\circ$, $50^\circ$, $80^\circ$. C: $90^\circ$, $45^\circ$, $45^\circ$. D: $100^\circ$, $40^\circ$, $40^\circ$. E: $70^\circ$, $60^\circ$, $50^\circ$. F: $80^\circ$, $50^\circ$, $50^\circ$. How many of the triangles are acute?
questions.solution: An acute triangle has all angles smaller than $90^\circ$. Triangles A, B, E and F qualify. C has a right angle and D has an obtuse angle. So 4 are acute.

questions.skill: Classify a triangle by its sides
questions.stem: A scalene triangle has two sides that measure 5 cm and 7 cm. The third side is a whole number of centimeters, longer than 7 cm and shorter than 9 cm. How many centimeters long is the third side?
questions.solution: The whole numbers between 7 and 9 are just 8. The sides 5 cm, 7 cm and 8 cm are all different, so the triangle is scalene.

solve.work: Whole number between 7 and 9 exclusive: 8. 5,7,8 is scalene.

questions.skill: Name a quadrilateral from its sides and angles
questions.stem: A quadrilateral has two pairs of parallel sides. It has no right angles, and its four sides are not all the same length. What is the most specific name for this shape?
questions.solution: Two pairs of parallel sides make it a parallelogram. It is not a rhombus (the sides are not all equal) and not a rectangle (it has no right angles).

solve.work: Two pairs of parallel sides, no right angles, sides not all equal: parallelogram (not rhombus or rectangle).

questions.skill: Parallel and perpendicular lines and sides
questions.stem: Quadrilateral ABCD has side AB parallel to side DC. Sides AD and BC are not parallel. The angles at A and at D are right angles. Which name fits this shape best?
questions.solution: Only one pair of sides (AB and DC) is parallel, so it is a trapezoid. A rectangle, a parallelogram and a rhombus all have two pairs of parallel sides.

solve.work: One pair of parallel sides (AB, DC), AD and BC not parallel: trapezoid (right trapezoid).

questions.skill: Parallel and perpendicular lines and sides
questions.stem: Which quadrilateral has opposite sides that are parallel but has no perpendicular sides?
choices: a trapezoid with two right angles
a parallelogram with no right angles
questions.answer: a parallelogram with no right angles
questions.solution: A parallelogram with no right angles has two pairs of parallel sides and no sides that meet at a right angle. Rectangles and squares have perpendicular sides, and the trapezoid has only one pair of parallel sides.

solve.answer: a parallelogram with no right angles
solve.work: Parallelogram with no right angles has parallel opposite sides and no perpendicular sides. Square and rectangle have perpendicular sides; a trapezoid with two right angles has perpendicular sides and only one parallel pair.

questions.skill: Classify a triangle by its angles and its sides
questions.stem: Triangle PQR has a $90^\circ$ angle at Q. Its sides measure 6 cm, 8 cm and 10 cm. How can the triangle be described by its angles and by its sides?
choices: a right triangle and a scalene triangle
a right triangle and an isosceles triangle
an acute triangle and a scalene triangle
an obtuse triangle and a scalene triangle
questions.answer: a right triangle and a scalene triangle
questions.solution: The $90^\circ$ angle makes it a right triangle, and its three sides are all different lengths, so it is also scalene.

solve.answer: a right triangle and a scalene triangle
solve.work: 90 degree angle: right; 6,8,10 all different: scalene.

questions.skill: Sort or count shapes by a property
questions.stem: Here are six shapes: a rectangle; a square; a rhombus with no right angles; a right triangle; a triangle with angles of $50^\circ$, $60^\circ$ and $70^\circ$; a trapezoid with two right angles. How many of these shapes have at least one right angle?
questions.solution: The rectangle, the square, the right triangle and the trapezoid with two right angles each have a right angle. The rhombus has none and the $50^\circ$, $60^\circ$, $70^\circ$ triangle has none. So 4 shapes qualify.

solve.work: Right angles: rectangle, square, right triangle, trapezoid with two right angles. Not the rhombus or the 50-60-70 triangle. 4.

questions.skill: Parallel and perpendicular lines and sides
questions.stem: A quadrilateral has four right angles. Which other fact must also be true?
choices: All four of its sides are equal in length
Exactly one pair of its sides is parallel
questions.solution: A quadrilateral with four right angles is a rectangle (or a square), so both pairs of opposite sides are parallel. Its sides need not all be equal, and it has no obtuse angles at all.

solve.work: Four right angles makes it a rectangle, so opposite sides are parallel.

questions.skill: Use the properties of a shape to find a length or count
questions.stem: A square and an equilateral triangle both have sides that are 9 cm long. How many centimeters greater is the perimeter of the square than the perimeter of the triangle?
questions.solution: The square has 4 sides of 9 cm, so its perimeter is 36 cm. The triangle has 3 sides of 9 cm, so its perimeter is 27 cm. The difference is $36 - 27 = 9$ cm.

questions.skill: Understand how quadrilateral classes overlap
questions.stem: Sam says, "Every square is a rectangle." Maria says, "Every rectangle is a square." Who is correct?
questions.solution: A square has 4 right angles and its opposite sides are equal and parallel, so it is a rectangle. A rectangle that is 3 cm by 5 cm has 4 right angles but sides of different lengths, so it is not a square. Only Sam is correct.

solve.work: A square has four right angles, so it is a rectangle. A rectangle need not have equal sides, so not every rectangle is a square. Only Sam.

questions.skill: Count the lines of symmetry of a shape
questions.stem: How many lines of symmetry does a square have?
questions.solution: A square can be folded along 2 lines through opposite corners and 2 lines through the middles of opposite sides. That is 4 lines.

questions.skill: Count the lines of symmetry of a shape
questions.stem: An equilateral triangle has 3 sides that are all the same length. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
questions.solution: Each line goes from a corner to the middle of the side across from it. There are 3 corners, so there are 3 lines.

solve.work: An equilateral triangle has 3 lines of symmetry.

questions.skill: Count the lines of symmetry of a shape
questions.stem: A rectangle is 9 cm long and 4 cm wide. It is not a square. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
questions.solution: One line runs down the middle the long way and one runs across the middle the short way. A rectangle that is not a square has 2 lines of symmetry.

solve.work: A non-square rectangle has 2 lines of symmetry (through midpoints of opposite sides); diagonals are not.

questions.skill: Recognise a figure or letter with line symmetry
questions.stem: Which of these flat shapes has no line of symmetry?
choices: a square with 4 equal sides and 4 square corners
a triangle with 3 sides of different lengths
a rectangle with two long sides and two short sides
a triangle with 3 sides that are all equal
questions.answer: a triangle with 3 sides of different lengths
questions.solution: A triangle whose 3 sides are all different cannot be folded so that its two halves match. The other shapes can be folded to match.

solve.answer: a triangle with 3 sides of different lengths
solve.work: Scalene triangle has no line of symmetry; rectangle 2, equilateral 3, square 4.

questions.skill: Use symmetry to find lengths and areas
questions.stem: A shape has a line of symmetry. One corner is 3 cm to the left of the line. The matching corner is on the right side of the line. How many centimeters to the right of the line is the matching corner?
questions.solution: Matching points are the same distance from the line of symmetry, so the matching corner is 3 cm to the right.

questions.skill: Recognise a figure or letter with line symmetry
questions.stem: Which of these block capital letters has a line of symmetry?
questions.solution: Fold the letter T down the middle of its upright part and the two halves match. F, G and R cannot be folded to match.

solve.work: T has a vertical line of symmetry; R, G and F have none.

questions.skill: Complete a figure that is symmetric about a line
questions.stem: A row of 6 squares has a line of symmetry down the middle. In the left 3 squares of the row, 2 squares are shaded. The row is symmetric. How many squares in the whole row are shaded?
questions.solution: The right 3 squares are a mirror image of the left 3, so they also have 2 shaded squares. In all, 2 + 2 = 4 squares are shaded.

solve.work: The 2 shaded squares on the left mirror to 2 on the right: 2 + 2 = 4.

questions.skill: Recognise a figure or letter with line symmetry
questions.stem: A triangle has sides of 6 cm, 6 cm and 4 cm. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
questions.solution: Two sides are equal, so the triangle can be folded from the corner between them to the middle of the 4 cm side. It has 1 line of symmetry.

solve.work: Isosceles but not equilateral: 1 line of symmetry (through the apex and the middle of the 4 cm base).

questions.skill: Test whether a line is a line of symmetry
questions.stem: A line of symmetry divides a flat shape into two parts. What is true about the two parts?
choices: They are the same shape but have different sizes
They touch each other at only one corner of the shape
They always have different areas from each other
They match exactly when the shape is folded on the line
questions.answer: They match exactly when the shape is folded on the line
questions.solution: Folding on a line of symmetry makes one part land exactly on the other, so the two parts match.

solve.answer: They match exactly when the shape is folded on the line
solve.work: A line of symmetry gives two halves that match when folded on the line.

questions.skill: Test whether a line is a line of symmetry
questions.stem: Maya folds a paper heart down the middle and the two halves match exactly. What is the fold line called?
questions.solution: A fold line that makes the two parts match is a line of symmetry.

solve.work: Folding so halves match exactly: the fold is a line of symmetry.

questions.skill: Recognise a figure or letter with line symmetry
questions.stem: Which triangle has exactly one line of symmetry?
choices: a triangle with sides 5 cm, 5 cm and 8 cm
a triangle with sides 5 cm, 5 cm and 5 cm
a triangle with sides 5 cm, 6 cm and 8 cm
a triangle with sides 4 cm, 7 cm and 9 cm
questions.answer: a triangle with sides 5 cm, 5 cm and 8 cm
questions.solution: A triangle with exactly two equal sides has one line of symmetry. Three equal sides give 3 lines, and three different sides give none.

solve.answer: a triangle with sides 5 cm, 5 cm and 8 cm
solve.work: Isosceles (5,5,8) has exactly one line; equilateral has 3; scalene has 0.

questions.skill: Test whether a line is a line of symmetry
questions.stem: Leo folds a rectangular paper (not a square) along a diagonal, from one corner to the opposite corner, and the two parts do not match. What does this show?
choices: A rectangle has no lines of symmetry
The paper has to be a square
The diagonal is not a line of symmetry of the rectangle
The diagonal is the only line of symmetry of a rectangle
questions.answer: The diagonal is not a line of symmetry of the rectangle
questions.solution: The parts do not match, so the diagonal is not a line of symmetry. A rectangle does have lines of symmetry, but they join the middles of opposite sides.

solve.answer: The diagonal is not a line of symmetry of the rectangle
solve.work: Halves do not match when folded on a diagonal, so the diagonal is not a line of symmetry (a non-square rectangle still has 2 lines through midpoints).

questions.skill: Recognise a figure or letter with line symmetry
questions.stem: Count the letters of the word SHAPE, written in block capitals, that have at least one line of symmetry. How many are there?
questions.solution: H, A and E can be folded so the halves match. S and P cannot. That is 3 letters.

solve.work: S: none; H: yes; A: yes (vertical); P: none; E: yes (horizontal). 3.

questions.skill: Count the lines of symmetry of a shape
questions.stem: A regular pentagon has 5 equal sides and 5 equal angles. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
questions.solution: A line goes from each corner to the middle of the side across from it. There are 5 corners, so there are 5 lines.

solve.work: Regular pentagon: 5 lines (each vertex to midpoint of opposite side).

questions.skill: Complete a figure that is symmetric about a line
questions.stem: A row has 8 squares, numbered 1 to 8 from the left. A line of symmetry runs down the middle, between squares 4 and 5. Square 2 is matched by a square on the other side of the line. What is the number of the matching square?
questions.solution: Square 4 matches square 5, square 3 matches 6 and square 2 matches 7. The two numbers in a pair add up to 9, so 9 - 2 = 7.

solve.work: Mirror over line between 4 and 5: n <-> 9-n. 2 <-> 7.

questions.skill: Relate a regular polygon to its lines of symmetry
questions.stem: A stop sign is a regular octagon with 8 equal sides and 8 equal angles. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
questions.solution: A regular shape has as many lines of symmetry as it has sides. An octagon has 8 sides, so it has 8 lines.

solve.work: A regular n-gon has n lines of symmetry: 8.

questions.skill: Place and describe lines of symmetry
questions.stem: Which statement about a rectangle that is not a square is true?
choices: It has 2 lines of symmetry, and both go through the corners
It has 2 lines of symmetry, and neither goes through a corner
It has 4 lines of symmetry, and two go through the corners
It has 1 line of symmetry, and it goes down the middle
questions.answer: It has 2 lines of symmetry, and neither goes through a corner
questions.solution: The two lines join the middles of opposite sides. A fold along a diagonal does not make the halves match, so no line goes through a corner.

solve.answer: It has 2 lines of symmetry, and neither goes through a corner
solve.work: Non-square rectangle: 2 lines of symmetry through midpoints of opposite sides, none through corners.

questions.skill: Use symmetry to find lengths and areas
questions.stem: A figure is cut out along a line of symmetry into two matching pieces. The whole figure has an area of 46 square centimeters. What is the area of one piece, in square centimeters?
questions.solution: Matching pieces have equal areas, so each piece is half of 46, which is 23 square centimeters.

solve.work: A line of symmetry splits the figure into two congruent halves: 46/2 = 23.

questions.skill: Recognise a figure or letter with line symmetry
questions.stem: In which list does every block capital letter have at least one line of symmetry?
questions.solution: A, M, T and U can each be folded so the halves match. F, R and J cannot.

solve.work: A, M, T, U each have a vertical line of symmetry. F, J, R have none.

questions.skill: Complete a figure that is symmetric about a line
questions.stem: A shape has a horizontal line of symmetry. A corner is 2 cm above the line. Where is the matching corner?
choices: 2 cm above the line, next to the first corner
4 cm below the line, under the first corner
2 cm below the line, under the first corner
on the line, under the first corner
questions.answer: 2 cm below the line, under the first corner
questions.solution: A matching point is the same distance from the line on the other side, so it is 2 cm below the line.

solve.answer: 2 cm below the line, under the first corner
solve.work: Reflection over a horizontal line: same distance on other side, directly below: 2 cm below.

questions.skill: Recognise a figure or letter with line symmetry
questions.stem: A shape has exactly 2 lines of symmetry. Which shape could it be?
choices: a rectangle that is not a square
a parallelogram with no square corners and sides of two different lengths
questions.answer: a rectangle that is not a square
questions.solution: A rectangle that is not a square has 2 lines. A square has 4, an equilateral triangle has 3, and the slanted parallelogram has none.

solve.answer: a rectangle that is not a square
solve.work: Non-square rectangle: 2 lines. Square 4, equilateral triangle 3, such parallelogram 0.

questions.skill: Relate a regular polygon to its lines of symmetry
questions.stem: A regular polygon has 7 lines of symmetry. How many sides does it have?
questions.solution: A regular polygon has one line of symmetry for each side, so 7 lines means 7 sides.

solve.work: A regular n-gon has n lines of symmetry; n = 7.

questions.skill: Place and describe lines of symmetry
questions.stem: Which block capital letter has both a vertical line of symmetry and a horizontal line of symmetry?
questions.solution: H matches when folded either down the middle or across the middle. A and T have only a vertical line, and E has only a horizontal line.

solve.work: H has vertical and horizontal lines; T and A only vertical; E only horizontal.

questions.skill: Place and describe lines of symmetry
questions.stem: A rectangle is 14 cm long and 6 cm wide. It is cut along both of its lines of symmetry into 4 matching rectangles. What is the perimeter of one small rectangle, in centimeters?
questions.solution: Each cut halves a side, so each small rectangle is 7 cm by 3 cm. Its perimeter is 2 x (7 + 3) = 20 cm.

solve.work: Cut along both symmetry lines: 7 cm by 3 cm pieces. Perimeter 2(7+3)=20.

questions.skill: Test whether a line is a line of symmetry
questions.stem: Ben says that a parallelogram with no square corners and sides of two different lengths has 2 lines of symmetry along its diagonals. Which statement is correct?
choices: Ben is right: the diagonals are its 2 lines of symmetry
Ben is wrong: it has 4 lines of symmetry in all
Ben is wrong: it has no lines of symmetry
Ben is wrong: it has 1 line of symmetry in all
questions.answer: Ben is wrong: it has no lines of symmetry
questions.solution: Folding such a parallelogram on a diagonal, or on a line through the middles of opposite sides, does not make the parts match. It has no lines of symmetry.

solve.answer: Ben is wrong: it has no lines of symmetry
solve.work: A parallelogram that is neither a rectangle nor a rhombus has no line of symmetry (its diagonals are not mirror lines).

questions.skill: Complete a figure that is symmetric about a line
questions.stem: A row has 6 squares, numbered 1 to 6 from the left. A line of symmetry runs down the middle, between squares 3 and 4. Squares 1 and 3 are shaded. Which squares must be shaded for the whole row to be symmetric?
questions.solution: Square 1 matches 6 and square 3 matches 4, so squares 1, 3, 4 and 6 are shaded.

solve.work: Mirror pairs across the line: 1-6, 2-5, 3-4. Shaded 1 and 3 need 6 and 4. Answer 1, 3, 4, 6.

questions.skill: Place and describe lines of symmetry
questions.stem: A regular hexagon has 6 lines of symmetry. Which description of them is correct?
choices: 3 go through opposite corners and 3 go through the middles of opposite sides
2 go through opposite corners and 4 go through the middles of opposite sides
4 go through opposite corners and 2 go through the middles of opposite sides
all 6 go through opposite corners and none go through the middles of sides
questions.answer: 3 go through opposite corners and 3 go through the middles of opposite sides
questions.solution: A hexagon has 6 corners, which make 3 pairs of opposite corners, and 6 sides, which make 3 pairs of opposite sides. That gives 3 + 3 = 6 lines.

solve.answer: 3 go through opposite corners and 3 go through the middles of opposite sides
solve.work: Regular hexagon: 3 lines through opposite vertices, 3 through midpoints of opposite sides.

questions.skill: Complete a figure that is symmetric about a line
questions.stem: A row has 10 squares, numbered 1 to 10 from the left, with a line of symmetry between squares 5 and 6. The row is symmetric. Squares 2, 3 and 8 are shaded. Exactly one more square is shaded. What is its number?
questions.solution: Square 3 matches 8 already. Square 2 matches 11 - 2 = 9, so square 9 is the one that is also shaded.

solve.work: Mirror between 5 and 6 maps k to 11-k: 2<->9, 3<->8. 2,3,8 shaded; 9 must be shaded.

questions.skill: Use symmetry to find lengths and areas
questions.stem: A shape has a vertical line of symmetry. Point A is 5 cm to the left of the line, and point B is the matching point on the right. How far apart are A and B, in centimeters?
questions.solution: B is also 5 cm from the line, on the other side. The distance from A to B is 5 + 5 = 10 cm.

solve.work: B is 5 cm right of the line; distance 5+5=10.
